entries.title: Psalms 107:1
segments: ¶Give ye thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 107:2
segments: Let the redeemed of Jehovah say so, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the oppressor,

entries.title: Psalms 107:3
segments: And gathered out of the countries, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the sea.

entries.title: Psalms 107:4
segments: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way, they found no city of habitation;

entries.title: Psalms 107:5
segments: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them:

entries.title: Psalms 107:6
segments: Then they cried unto Jehovah in their trouble, [and] he delivered them out of their distresses,

entries.title: Psalms 107:7
segments: And he led them forth by a right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.

entries.title: Psalms 107:8
segments: Let them give thanks unto Jehovah for his loving-kindness, and for his wondrous works to the children of men;

entries.title: Psalms 107:9
segments: For he hath satisfied the longing soul and filled the hungry soul with good.

entries.title: Psalms 107:10
segments: ¶Such as inhabit darkness and the shadow of death, bound in affliction and iron,

entries.title: Psalms 107:11
segments: Because they had rebelled against the words of *God, and had despised the counsel of the Most High; ...

entries.title: Psalms 107:12
segments: And he bowed down their heart with labour; they stumbled, and there was none to help:

entries.title: Psalms 107:13
segments: Then they cried unto Jehovah in their trouble, [and] he saved them out of their distresses;

entries.title: Psalms 107:14
segments: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke their bands in sunder.

entries.title: Psalms 107:15
segments: Let them give thanks unto Jehovah for his loving-kindness, and for his wondrous works to the children of men;

entries.title: Psalms 107:16
segments: For he hath broken the gates of bronze, and cut asunder the bars of iron.

entries.title: Psalms 107:17
segments: ¶Fools, because of their way of transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted;

entries.title: Psalms 107:18
segments: Their soul abhorreth all manner of food, and they draw near unto the gates of death:

entries.title: Psalms 107:19
segments: Then they cry unto Jehovah in their trouble, [and] he saveth them out of their distresses;

entries.title: Psalms 107:20
segments: He sendeth his word, and healeth them, and delivereth them from their destructions.

entries.title: Psalms 107:21
segments: Let them give thanks unto Jehovah for his loving-kindness, and for his wondrous works to the children of men,

entries.title: Psalms 107:22
segments: And let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works in joyful song.

entries.title: Psalms 107:23
segments: ¶They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters,

entries.title: Psalms 107:24
segments: These see the works of Jehovah, and his wonders in the deep.

entries.title: Psalms 107:25
segments: For he speaketh, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifteth up the waves thereof:

entries.title: Psalms 107:26
segments: They mount up to the heavens, they go down to the depths; their soul is melted because of trouble;

entries.title: Psalms 107:27
segments: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and they are at their wits' end:

entries.title: Psalms 107:28
segments: Then they cry unto Jehovah in their trouble, and he bringeth them out of their distresses;

entries.title: Psalms 107:29
segments: He maketh the storm a calm, and the waves thereof are still:

entries.title: Psalms 107:30
segments: And they rejoice because they are quiet; and he bringeth them unto their desired haven.

entries.title: Psalms 107:31
segments: Let them give thanks unto Jehovah for his loving-kindness, and for his wondrous works to the children of men;

entries.title: Psalms 107:32
segments: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the session of the elders.

entries.title: Psalms 107:33
segments: ¶He maketh rivers into a wilderness, and water-springs into dry ground;

entries.title: Psalms 107:34
segments: A fruitful land into a plain of salt, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.

entries.title: Psalms 107:35
segments: He maketh the wilderness into a pool of water, and the dry land into water-springs;

entries.title: Psalms 107:36
segments: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, and they establish a city of habitation;

entries.title: Psalms 107:37
segments: And sow fields, and plant vineyards, which yield fruits of increase;

entries.title: Psalms 107:38
segments: And he blesseth them, so that they are multiplied greatly; and he suffereth not their cattle to decrease.

entries.title: Psalms 107:39
segments: And they are diminished and brought low, through oppression, adversity, and sorrow:

entries.title: Psalms 107:40
segments: He poureth contempt upon nobles, and causeth them to wander in a pathless waste;

entries.title: Psalms 107:41
segments: But he secureth the needy one on high from affliction, and maketh [him] families like flocks.

entries.title: Psalms 107:42
segments: The upright shall see it, and rejoice; and all unrighteousness shall stop its mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 107:43
segments: Whoso is wise, let him observe these things, and let them understand the loving-kindnesses of Jehovah.
